moto.note: virtual camera ~10 cm behind the rider eyes pitched down 35 deg; its own horizon is above the frame, so the overlay is a stylised lower-periphery view: just draw it full-screen over the road (horizon 40 %). Rider head/torso hidden; speedometer needle fixed at ~38 km/h.

wheel.note: draw at pos (top-left, cockpit frame px), rotate around pivot; the wheel faces the eye so a 2D rotation is exact; it extends below the 740 px frame
